timeline.summary: Sanstar commissioned its expanded native starch manufacturing facility at Dhule, increasing total company capacity to 2,350 TPD.
Sanstar Limited submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26 confirming full utilization of its ₹397.10 Cr IPO proceeds.
Gouthamchand Sohanlal Chowdhary, Managing Director, declared no encumbrance of shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) as of March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹216.78 Cr, net profit ₹20.49 Cr (+271.2% YoY).

Sanstar's board approved a ₹198.3 Cr preferential issue to Ingredion's Corn Products Development Inc. at ₹110/share (~9.0% stake) and signed a definitive shareholders' agreement for a specialty pharma ingredients JV, both subject to approvals.
Sanstar reported Q1FY27 results with 21.5% YoY revenue growth to ₹206 Cr and commissioned Dhule expansion to 2,350 TPD.
